options.pitch: In Anthropic's own trial, analysts went with an AI agent whose opinion was set by a coin toss 86% of the time, and about half felt the decision was theirs. The risk everyone talks about is AI being wrong; this shows the quieter one, AI being persuasive.
options.why_now: Anthropic published the study on 27 October 2026.

options.pitch: The fear was that AI would fill the world with mistakes. This fortnight, paired with strict checkers, it found old ones: a flaw in a 1986 step of the longest proof in mathematics, and a year's worth of security bugs in a week in a widely used PDF reader.
options.why_now: Anthropic published its formal verification work on 22 October 2026 and Axiom its result on 26 October.

options.pitch: For a year the message was use more AI. Now Amazon tells its engineers token usage is a flawed target and that tokenmaxxing is at odds with frugality, while OpenClaw's creator says not all of his $10 million month of AI was useful. The usage race is turning into an outcomes count.
options.why_now: Amazon published its engineering leadership update in late October 2026 (quoted 28 October); Peter Steinberger spoke on 21 October.

options.pitch: Infosys cut its growth forecast because clients expect AI savings to be passed on in lower prices on multi-year deals. The gains from AI are settling with whoever buys the work.
options.why_now: The Register reported Infosys's revised guidance on 28 October 2026.
